summary: Guard Dog M1 iteration 3 — real controlled endpoint injected via backend/.env WITHOUT resigning the live bundle. All spec assertions verified end-to-end against the public URL (https://guard-dog-m1.preview.emergentagent.com). Backend (pytest 3/3 pass, new /app/backend/tests/test_m1_iter3_real_endpoint.py): (1) GET /api/config -> controlledEndpoint={host:'blocktest.btciq.app', ipv4:'52.25.179.131', url:'https://blocktest.btciq.app/', isPlaceholder:false}; signing config unchanged (enabled:true, requiresAdminToken:true, requiresConfirm:true, allowedRulesets:['gd-m1-controlled-block']). (2) GET /api/rules/gd-m1-controlled-block/latest -> bundleVersion=17, keyId='gd-m1-test-ed25519-001', signature present; rule hosts = ['m1-block-test.guarddog.example','evil.example'] and DO NOT include 'blocktest.btciq.app' (bundle intentionally not resigned yet; POST /api/rules/sign NOT called in this run per instructions). (3) POST /api/intelligence/lookup {url:'https://blocktest.btciq.app/x?t=1'} -> verdict='unknown', degraded=true, sanitizedUrl='https://blocktest.btciq.app/x' (mocked Web Risk unconfigured; source='none'). Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): harness-screen loads clean (no red screen, no console errors); config-host='blocktest.btciq.app', config-ipv4='52.25.179.131', config-ruleset='gd-m1-controlled-block', bundle-version='v17 · 2 rule(s)'; analyze-url-input pre-filled with 'https://blocktest.btciq.app/login?token=SECRET' (matches spec exactly); blocked-count='0' before and after run. Clicking run-proof-button drives runAndroidBlockingProof which now stops after step 'start' because the pre-conditions gate fires; the six emitted steps match the spec verbatim: config PASS ('blocktest.btciq.app -> 52.25.179.131'), bundle PASS ('v17 keyId=gd-m1-test-ed25519-001 rules=2'), verify BLOCKED ('native verifier unavailable in this runtime'), before PASS ('reachable (opaque cross-origin response)') — the critical assertion of this round, driven by mode:'no-cors' in the web probe and the real host being resolvable/reachable, — consent BLOCKED ('unsupported: web runtime has no enforcement layer'), start SKIPPED ('prerequisites not met; nothing started, nothing claimed'). No 'after'/'blocked'/'unrelated' steps are rendered (short-circuit path is honored). harness-verdict='Proof incomplete: requires Android native build + real controlled endpoint.'. No [data-testid="event-THREAT_BLOCKED"] element exists in the DOM. Note on harness gating: because isPlaceholderEndpoint is now computed as endsWith('.example')==false for 'blocktest.btciq.app', a hypothetical fetch failure would surface as before=FAIL instead of BLOCKED; today the opaque cross-origin GET succeeds so this is not exercised.
critical_code_review_comments: androidBlockingProofHarness.ts uses `host.endsWith('.example')` as the placeholder heuristic. This coincidentally aligns with backend `controlled_endpoint_is_placeholder`, but the two signals are independent. Consider consuming `config.controlledEndpoint.isPlaceholder` directly to avoid drift if a future placeholder is chosen from a different TLD.

The live bundle still contains a stale rule for 'm1-block-test.guarddog.example' plus a canonicalization probe 'evil.example'. When infrastructure confirmation lands, the resigning POST must include the new controlled-host block for 'blocktest.btciq.app' to satisfy the enforce_controlled_configuration guard (which today expects 'm1-block-test.guarddog.example' — verify the guard is updated in the same change set that resigns v18).

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 iter3 spec tests; previous 104 regressions unchanged)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all spec assertions verified on live URL)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only run — POST /api/rules/sign and /api/keys/*/retire were deliberately NOT called per the agent-to-agent context note. Bundle remains at v17 as required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://guard-dog-m1.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin header for future signing calls: X-GuardDog-Admin-Token: m1-dev-admin-token-change-me. When the resigning round arrives (v18), the signing POST payload MUST include the new controlled-host block for 'blocktest.btciq.app' AND the enforce_controlled_configuration guard in the backend must be updated in the same PR to expect 'blocktest.btciq.app' instead of 'm1-block-test.guarddog.example' — otherwise the sign call will 422 with CONTROLLED_CONFIG_MISMATCH. The harness step 'before' currently PASSES via an opaque no-cors GET; on Android native the same step will run without the CORS constraint. Do NOT click export-pdf-button in headless web tests (opens the browser print dialog).
rca_of_issue: No product defects detected this iteration. The intentional inconsistency (real endpoint injected, bundle still v17 with placeholder host) is fully reflected on the wire and in the UI: /api/intelligence/lookup returns verdict=unknown+degraded=true because no signed rule matches 'blocktest.btciq.app' yet; the harness emits config PASS + bundle PASS but stops at start SKIPPED because the (web) consent step is BLOCKED, so blocked-count stays at 0 and no THREAT_BLOCKED event is manufactured. Backend and frontend behavior are consistent with an unresigned bundle.
